label: CP7_OW12A_FINANCE_CAPTURE_NATIVE7
database_start: supabase start succeeded on attempt 1 from ghcr.io

earlier_runs_same_commit_family.39854094236: registry image limits after ghcr login

cause: Installer admission, not product: the install SQL ran (the SET ROLE handover works); the 22-group admission then saw PostgreSQL's internal RI_FKey triggers created for the chunks->captures foreign key, and the stage's allow-list for new private objects had no trigger group.
fix: Admit only internal RI_FKey triggers on the stage's own schema (the stage declares no trigger); every other new trigger is still refused. Sibling stages admit all triggers in their schema; this is narrower.
